research_rationale:
EO:8538: producer recheck of the full held APP working text against the held GPO printing, with exact APP page record/hash verification. One operative personal exemption states its own end, 1941-09-30, inclusive; the exclusive reading (ending when that day begins) is disclosed. A fixed term supplies expiry without assuming any actual retirement, separation or performance event. Own APP has see. 715a where GPO has sec. 715a. This disclosed nonmaterial abbreviation typo does not change the expressly identified section 204 authority or personal exemption/end date. The OFR note explicitly says Revoked by: EO 8905, September 22, 1941; this is an asserted earlier-end candidate (1941-09-22), not omitted evidence. The complete held APP and GPO texts of EO 8905 recite the prior exemption and further exempt the same employee for one year ending September 30, 1942; neither contains a revocation, rescission, shortening or supersession command. A further grant can coexist with the earlier permission through its stated term. I therefore do not infer an earlier revocation from the editorial label; the operative source supports the stated own-term end. This is a producer replacement proposal, not independent review or owner adoption. original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved.
